# Beds

The Rowan platform bed is made from FSC-certified oak veneer over engineered wood. Double, king, and super king frame sizes are offered. The king frame measures 166 cm wide by 215 cm long, with a 34 cm headboard depth. Mattresses are sold separately.

# Care and compatibility

Use a damp, soft cloth and dry immediately. Do not use silicone polish. The frame accepts standard UK mattress dimensions and requires the supplied center support rail. Under-bed clearance is 18 cm.
